notes.title: Simplified gameplay
notes.notes: Now we make more understandable and simple gameplay, with a lot of tips in the escape mode. Players tested the escape mode at the initial stage, indicated to us all the minuses and mistakes we made in the development, and we will correct them, so in the near future the gameplay will be easier and more interesting. Please do not judge strictly as this is our first project. Leave your wishes in the comments, we will listen to your opinion and try to add to the game what you would like to see in it, thank you.

notes.title: AMD video cards
notes.notes: Users of the AMD graphics card can have problems when starting the game. To resolve this issue, check your tessellation settings. AMD settings / Game / The Frost / Tessellation settings / use application settings. If it does not work try changing other parameters in the video card settings.
